newsitem.title: USA: Lott sees Gingrich playing key role.
newsitem.headline: Lott sees Gingrich playing key role.

text.p: Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott, R-Mississippi, said Tuesday that despite Rep. Newt Gingrich's ethics investigation, he will be re-elected as House Speaker and will play a "key role" in the new congressional session.
"I anticipate Speaker Gingraich will be re-elected Speaker," Lott said at a news conference.

Lott dismissed as "pure speculation" questions about whether the Senate would now take the lead on legislation as a result of Gingrich's ethics investigation. "That is not the way I am inclined to work," Lott told reporters. The lead will shift depending on the issue, he said.
